description: List raw decoded The Standard Reserve (TSR) protocol events on Robinhood Chain, newest first. Filter by contract_label, event_name, tx_hash, block_number, log_index, from_address, to_address, owner, token_id, or epoch, and paginate with before (a "block_number:log_index" cursor, exclusive) and limit. Use this for an audit trail of what happened; use the other 1s_std_* tools for current or aggregated state.

block_number.description: Exact block number to filter by

event_name.description: Decoded event name to filter by

log_index.description: Exact log index to filter by (usually paired with block_number)

token_id.description: Token id (numeric string) to filter by

name: 1s_std_events
title: TSR Event Feed
